Troop,Ⓒs.Ⓓ(‘T(roop)s’) sEnikAH, padAtayaH, sEnyaM; See Force.

 2 gulmaH-lmaM, dalaM.
Ⓑ

Ⓝ[Troop]er,Ⓒs.ⒹsAdin m., aSvArohaH.

Trot,Ⓒs.ⒹDo(DO)rita-takaM.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹDoritena yA 2 P or gam 1 P.
Troth,Ⓒs.ⒹviSvAsaH, pratyayaH; ‘by my t(roth)’ satyameva, yadi tava mayi viSvAsaH.

Trouble,Ⓒs.ⒹkazwaM, duHKaM, pIqA, kleSaH, pra-A-yAsaH, KedaH, kfcCraM; A-vi-pad f., durdaSA, bADA, uparoDaH.
Ⓑ
 2 yatnaH, udyamaH; See Pains.
Ⓑ
 3 kaMwakaH, AyAsakaH, SalyaM.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹbAD 1 A, pIq 10, kliS 9 P, uparuD 7 U, Ayas c.; saM-pari-tap c.; See Afflict; ‘t(roubl)ed at heart’ KinnAMtaHkaraRa, udvignacitta and sim. comp.; ‘Oh! do not t(rouble) yourself’ alamAtmAnamAyAsya, kftaM kftaM AyA-sena.
Ⓝ[Troubl]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹbADita, pIqita &c., vyagra, udvigna, kAtara, vihvala, Arta, viklava.
Ⓝ[Trouble]some,Ⓒa.Ⓓkazwa-pIqA-kara (rI f.), pIqAprada, kleSAvaha, duHKAvaha, duzwa, AyAsahetuka; ‘a t(roublesome) fellow’ kaMwakaH.
ⓃTroublous,Ⓒa.ⒹkzubDa, sopaplava.
